newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair calendar '96 passengers up 6.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnair calendar '96 passengers up 6.2 pct.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said in a statement received on Thursday that the number of passengers who flew Finnair in calendar 1996 rose 6.2 percent year-on-year to a new record, 6.21 million passengers.
Finnair said passenger growth on international scheduled flights was 3.5 percent.
The number of passengers on Finnair's domestic scheduled flights rose 8.3 percent and on charter flights the rise was 12.9 percent.
Finnair's air cargo transport increased 6.6 percent year-on-year in 1996 to 55,000 tonnes and mail transport rose 6.8 percent to 9,300 tonnes, the airline said.
